title: Integration Testing
diagramContent:
graph TD
  Test[Jest Test Suite] -->|HTTP GET /users| Server[Express App in Memory]
  Server -->|Query| DB[(Test Database)]
  DB -->|Data| Server
  Server -->|200 OK + JSON| Test
  Test --> Assert[expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200)]
definition: Integration testing involves spinning up the actual Express server and sending real HTTP requests to the endpoints to ensure the Router, Middleware, and Controllers all work together seamlessly. This is typically done using `Supertest`.

answers.question: Define Integration Testing in your own words.
answers.answer: Integration testing involves spinning up the actual Express server and sending real HTTP requests to the endpoints to ensure the Router, Middleware, and Controllers all work together seamlessly.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Integration Testing?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
